verses.text: A song of ascents. By Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, the builders work for nothing. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the guard stays up for nothing.
There’s no point in getting up early and staying up late just to eat bread you wore yourself out for. God gives sleep to the people he loves.
Look, children are an inheritance from the LORD. Children born to you are his reward.
Children born when you’re young are like arrows in a warrior’s hand.
Happy is the parent with a quiver full of them. They won’t hang their heads when they speak to their enemies at the gate.
